reviews.text: De lo último en tecnología, revise los ingredientes y con las reseñas me anime a pedirlo, tengo curiosidad de usar estos productos por su alta efectividad y adicional estaba a buen precio ya que venía en pack de 2. Una vez que los termine, actualizaré mi reseña.
reviews.zh: 我喺最新科技入面睇咗成分，又睇咗評論，所以鼓起勇氣買咗。我好想試吓呢啲產品，因為佢哋效果好高，而且價錢仲好抵，因為係兩件裝。等我用完之後，我會更新我嘅評論。

reviews.text: Serum z mikro igiełkami oraz witaminą C bardzo dobrze się sprawdza na mojej skurza. Dzięki działaniom mikroigieł składniki serum wchłaniają się w głąb skóry bardzo dobrze. Skóra jest gładka o wyrównuje strukturze.
reviews.zh: 帶微針同維他命 C 嘅精華，用喺我嘅皮膚上效果好好。多得微針嘅作用，精華成分好好咁滲入皮膚深層。皮膚變得平滑，膚質結構都均勻咗。

reviews.text: I have repurchased this serum twice already and have gotten another family member hooked onto it too. With consistent second daily use, it produces great result. It gave our skin a beautiful glow after a few weeks of usage. The product stings a little on application but it was barely noticeable to us. If you're looking to try a spicule products that helps with brightening and glowing effect, dont hesitate to try this. You won't regret it!
reviews.zh: 我已經買咗兩次呢款精華，仲令家人都迷上咗。每日用兩次，堅持使用，效果好好。用咗幾個星期之後，皮膚有咗一陣漂亮嘅光澤。產品喺塗抹嗰時會有少少刺痛，不過我哋兩個都覺得幾乎感覺唔到。如果你想搵一款有 spicule 成分、幫助提亮同光澤效果嘅產品，就唔好猶豫，試吓啦。你唔會後悔嘅！

reviews.text:
Es un serum ampolla de vitamina C pura y exosomas junto con la niacinamida que ayuda a nutrir, iluminar, fortalecer la barrera cutánea.
Es de textura ligera y se absorbe rápido, las espículas se notan un montón cuando masajeas la piel, se suele irritar un poco la piel, se pone roja , pero al rato se baja la rojez dejando una piel muy iluminada. Llevo un tiempo utilizando y me gusta mucho como me deja la piel, más tersa, firme y iluminada además de ir aclarando el tono de mi piel.
El empaquetado es precioso muy bonito.
reviews.zh:
呢款係純正維他命 C 同外泌體嘅安瓶精華，加埋煙酰胺，有助滋養、提亮、加強皮膚屏障。
質地輕盈，吸收快，按摩皮膚時會好明顯感覺到 spicules，塗完皮膚通常會有啲刺激、會紅，但係過一陣紅位就會退，留低一個好亮嘅皮膚。我用咗一段時間，好鍾意佢令皮膚更加緊緻、堅實、亮白，而且慢慢淡化咗膚色。
包裝好靚，好精美。

reviews.text: lo acabo de probar. Tenía miedo por si lo de las espículas dolía. Tengo piel sensible y no sentí nada dramático. Realmente, una muy ligera molestia. Pero realmente, muy ligera. El en base es perfecto para que el producto no se oxide. Es de válvula para que no entre aire.
reviews.zh: 我啱啱試咗。我好驚會唔會痛，因為有啲 spicules。我皮膚敏感，但係冇感到咩好強烈嘅痛楚。真係，好輕微嘅不適。真係好輕微。底座設計得好好，可以防止產品氧化；佢係活塞式，所以空氣唔會入去。

reviews.text:
Gut Tôi đã nhận được Bộ Serum Vitaminol Youth Radiance như một sản phẩm tặng kèm Glow Up. Bộ sản phẩm bao gồm Sữa rửa mặt dạng dầu tạo bọt, hai loại serum: Serum Vitaminol Youth Radiance và Serum Organience Barrier Repair Seed Peptide Reserve, cùng Kem dưỡng Organience Barrier Repair Seed Peptide Reserve.
AG.VCN(tm) Sữa rửa mặt dạng dầu tạo bọt hoàn hảo: dầu ưa nước giúp tẩy trang, hương thơm dễ chịu. Thoa lên mặt, massage, tạo bọt với một ít nước và rửa sạch. Cả lớp trang điểm chống nước và không chống nước đều dễ dàng được tẩy sạch, ngay cả với nước ấm. Không để lại cảm giác nhờn/nhờn trên da. Không gây kích ứng mắt. Được khuyên dùng để tẩy trang.
reviews.zh:
Gut 我已經收到咗 Vitaminol Youth Radiance 精華套裝，作為 Glow Up 嘅贈品。套裝包括一支泡沫油型潔面乳、兩款精華：Vitaminol Youth Radiance 精華，同 Organience Barrier Repair Seed Peptide Reserve 精華，仲有 Organience Barrier Repair Seed Peptide Reserve 面霜。
AG.VCN(tm) 泡沫油型潔面乳嘅完美之處：親水油可以卸妝，香味令人舒服。塗喺面上、按摩、加少少水起泡，然後沖洗乾淨。防水同非防水嘅妝都容易被徹底卸除，即使用溫水都得。冇留低油膩嘅感覺。唔會刺激眼睛。推薦用嚟卸妝。

reviews.text: I am really enjoying this. The spicules are not too prickly and it does not hurt at all to use. I enjoy using it at night when I still want a brightening product in my routine but do not want to use a vitamin c like I use in the morning. It will take more time for me to see substancial reaults, but so far so good.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款。啲 spicules 唔係好刺，用嘅時候完全唔痛。我好鍾意夜晚用，因為我想喺護膚程序入面多啲提亮嘅產品，但係又唔想用我早上用嗰款維他命 C。要花多啲時間先會見到實質效果，但係目前都幾好。

reviews.text: I like this spicule serum. I have been struggling with acne and comedones and nothing was working before introducing this into my routine. Since using it my skin has been silky and flawless, there are no clogged pores. I only use it once a week during weekends when I don't need to apply makeup. I highly recommend this if you struggle with the same issue.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款 spicule 精華。我一直都受暗瘡同粉刺困擾，之前試過嘅嘢都冇用，直到加咗呢款入護膚程序。用咗之後，我嘅皮膚變得絲滑無瑕，冇粉刺。我淨係週末用，當我唔需要化妝嗰時。如果你同樣有呢個問題，我強烈推薦。
